prompt: Create one CHECK MARK game UI symbol that belongs to the exact same illustrated Mediterranean art kit as these references. Reference 1 is the existing terracotta cancel symbol: match its fine dark-brown ink contour, sparse hatching, restrained watercolor wash and small hand-painted irregularities. Reference 2 is the existing warm bronze-and-ivory coin: match its warm earthy palette and delicate ink quality. Draw a simple bold tick: two joined strokes, a short left arm and a long rising right arm. The strokes are clearly GREEN, in warm leaf/olive green with a lighter yellow-green watercolor wash inside and a fine brown ink outline. It must read as green at 20 pixels on an ivory coin face. Keep strokes thick enough to read, but use a flat painted illustration, with subtle pigment texture rather than a polished bevel or metallic shine. No emerald jewel, no glossy plastic, no neon color, no modern app-logo treatment. Front-on view. Only the check mark, no coin or round background, no text, no letters, no ornaments, no cast shadow. Center the check mark in a square, filling 80 percent of the frame, on pure white for transparent cutout.
